name: Officer Meter
blurb: A parking officer who has never once let anything go. Writes the ticket during the chase.

look.description: A parking officer in a hi-vis vest and peaked cap, the ticket printer on his belt already warm.

meta.notes: The region's local cop (playtest 1c), so a San Francisco race fields its own law as the Keys race fields Sgt. Pruitt. The law block copies Pruitt's numbers except two: the fine is a little higher, because it is San Francisco, and he needs 2 s beside you to bust you (Pruitt needs 1 s), because he writes the ticket out in full. He carries the baton (the cops polish round, 2026-10-01: each region's cop is armed, per M4 cops-3), so you can snatch it off him mid-swing; the baton, not the taser, because the city course already busts the dev bot most often. The city course gives more crashes than the causeway, and with a 1 s dwell half the bot's seeded races ended in a bust right after a traffic crash. [default] Run W-T (law with a personality): his habit is `budget`. He chases on a 30 s pursuit budget (all race); spent, he pulls over for good ('Pursuit budget exhausted. Fiscal year resets in July.') and is never sent again, by the heat or for a roadblock. [default]
